item.title: Police nab 61-year-old man for shooting in St. Thomas nearly 20 years ago
item.description: He has been identified as Collin Mowatt, otherwise called ‘tumpa’ or ‘tumpa dragon’. Reports indicate that at about 1:30 p.m. on Tuesday, January 24, 2006, Mowatt allegedly approached a woman with two firearms and shot her before fleeing the parish. item.title: Tufton says Cornwall Regional Hospital nears full operation within 1-2 weeks
item.description: Health Minister, Dr. Christopher Tufton says the Cornwall Regional Hospital in St. James is on track to return to its pre-hurricane Melissa operating capacity within the next one to two weeks. Providing an update at a media briefing in Montego Bay yesterday, Dr. Tufton said the facility has seen significant improvements since the Category 5 hurricane in October 2025. item.title: CARICOM to respond to humanitarian crisis in Cuba within a month
item.description: The Caribbean Community (CARICOM) says it will respond to help address the growing humanitarian crisis in Cuba. The United States of America (U.S.A.) had implemented measures to cut off Cuba's oil supply, which has affected other key sectors in that island such as healthcare. item.title: Olympic silver medallist Kishane Thompson headlines a star-studded lineup for 26th staging of the Gibson/Mckook Relays
